dedupe_keys.name: florida critical community and emergency facilities resilient florida statewide layers

description: This group of statewide layers holds Florida's critical community and emergency facilities as defined in section 380.093(2)(a) of the Florida Statutes (the Resilient Florida programme), developed for the Department of Environmental Protection by the Balmoral Group from various public state and federal sources. Sixteen layers cover affordable public housing, colleges and universities, community centres, correctional facilities, disaster recovery centres, emergency medical service facilities, emergency operations centres, fire stations (1,876 when read), health care facilities, hospitals (351), law enforcement facilities, local government facilities, logistical staging areas, the risk shelter inventory (1,978), schools (5,381) and state government facilities. Fields include name, address, county, coordinates, parcel ID, facility type, asset elevation, owner, asset type and group, relevancy, municipality, water management district and source dataset. Coverage: Florida. Access: free feature service and downloads. Licence: FDEP terms, provided without warranty. Caveats: compiled from sources of different dates and quality. Simulation uses: the layers are used in vulnerability assessments of exposure to sea level rise, precipitation, storms and flooding and in the statewide assessment. Related records: the Miami-Dade open evacuation centres and the USGS National Structures Dataset.
